title: Consolidation: Hungarian Communities Across the Carpathian Basin Today

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can analyze the institutional, educational, and cultural life of Hungarian communities across the Carpathian Basin.
I can master complex concessive conditional structures (még akkor is, ha; még ha ... volna is; függetlenül attól, hogy; dacára; bármilyen ... is legyen).
I can discuss minority rights, mother-tongue universities, dual citizenship, and European cross-border cooperation in fluent B2 Hungarian.
